# Capsule Explorer

> A browser-native viewer for qp-capsule hashchains. Every action an AI agent
> takes is sealed into a capsule (six sections: trigger, context, reasoning,
> authority, execution, outcome), hash-linked to the previous one, and signed.
> The explorer re-verifies the whole chain in your browser, offline, with no
> backend and no trust required.

## What it proves

- Each capsule is content-hashed with SHA3-256 over canonical JSON.
- Each hash is signed with Ed25519 (optionally ML-DSA-65 post-quantum).
- Each capsule links to the previous capsule's hash, forming a tamper-evident chain.
- Reorder, edit, or drop any capsule and verification fails at the exact break point.

## How verification works here

The page recomputes SHA3-256 over the exact canonical bytes, verifies the Ed25519
signature against the chain's public key, and checks previous-hash linkage and
sequence order. All client-side. The "Tamper test" mutates one byte to show the
chain break in real time.

## Key concepts

- Capsule: an immutable, signed record of one agent action.
- Hashchain: capsules linked by previous_hash, sequence-ordered.
- Seal: SHA3-256 hash + Ed25519 signature, applied at creation time.
